title: Bands around Austin and the Oleander Orchestra
summary: Top Black bands near Austin were Troy and Trent; the Oleander Orchestra of Galveston took its name from the tree.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Back to Texas, were there many bands around Austin?

No, the biggest bands there was Troy, that is the Negro bands you're referring to, right? Either way. Well, I can't vividly remember the big white bands. One of them I remember was Furman Walden, and then it was Troy and it was Trent. Those were the names. Of course, we had the Oleana Orchestra in Galveston. And that's the one that Claude Kennedy went to. Yeah, I don't know the Oleana. No, it didn't last long.
Yeah, well, Oleana is named after the Galveston. That's the tree there. Oleana tree, so the band picked up the name.
